fields.description: Issue dated December 24, 1949 (Vol. XXIII, No. 52) featuring editorials and local reporting on Miami municipal politics under Mayor Bill Wolfarth, including criticism of proposed water-rate increases and tax-office consolidation; downtown retail conditions during the Christmas season with Burdine's reporting a major drop in anticipated profits and reduced employee bonuses; Miami Beach hotel industry efforts to restore a "liberal policy" amid concerns about enforcement campaigns and gambling; discussion of non-enforcement of an anti-cigarette ordinance and broader commentary on public health and media influence; additional items include traffic-safety messaging, court coverage (including a prostitution-related case), tourism/visitor surveys, dog racing attendance, and airline service news.
